img.caption: Fig 2: Main results. (a) Macro-F1 on CLINC150 and Hit@1 on multi-intent MixATIS/MixSNIPS; (b) set-level Jaccard. Hatched n/a: CICC was only run on single-intent CLINC150; set IoU is not defined for single-label conformal baselines. MULACONF's high Hit@1 on MixATIS (0.73) comes from emitting 150-intent sets (Jaccard drops to 0.35); QP-10-shot trails on both. Ours attains the best CLINC150 Macro-F1 (0.899) and MixSNIPS Jaccard (0.757) with tight 1.5-1.8-intent sets, no task-specific training.
